title: VisionQuest is what happens when AI really goes rogue

claims.claim: Marvel's VisionQuest is a Disney Plus series that follows the synthezoid Vision, played by Paul Bettany.

evidence.quote: Marvel’s latest Disney Plus series is a reminder of how much a lot of gen AI hype is just science fiction.
VisionQuest picks up some time after Agatha All Along and follows synthezoid Vision (Paul Bettany) on a journey of self-discovery.

claims.claim: Vision can recall the details of his death in Avengers: Infinity War and how WandaVision brought a version of him back.

evidence.quote: This Vision can recall the details of his death in Avengers: Infinity War and how WandaVision brought a version of him back

This Vision can recall the details of his death in Avengers: Infinity War and how WandaVision brought a version of him back, but he thinks of himself as a fundamentally different person who doesn’t quite connect with all of the memories in his databanks.

claims.claim: Characters J.A.R.V.I.S., F.R.I.D.A.Y., E.D.I.T.H., D.U.M.-E., U., and Ultron in VisionQuest were all created by Tony Stark and are voiced by actors such as James D'Arcy, Orla Brady, Emily Hampshire, Henry Lewis, Jonathan Sayer, and James Spader.
